card.name: Garbled fraction and markup symbols
card.fires_on: Odd symbols inside broken or encoded text, such as the word frac in "½" entities, tildes in pronunciation guides, or stray characters in URLs and code. Fires mostly where the text looks like corrupted or escaped markup.
